evidence.note: Ran a per-stage breakdown that pinpointed permute/contiguous copies (~8.6ms) as the bottleneck; when torch.compile failed due to Dynamo/CUDAGraph interaction with the cached weight, diagnosed the cause and pivoted the design to fused Triton packing rather than tweaking compile flags.

Root-caused the remaining ~5.9ms gate_pack cost to strided/scattered [B,H,N,N] stores, hypothesized a coalesced tiled (K,H) kernel, fixed a tl.cdiv constexpr compile error, and re-verified — a targeted design change that resolved the bottleneck (N=1024 dropped to ~6.9ms).

Clearly distinguished performance vs correctness: bf16 intermediates failed tolerance by a wide margin → reverted; fp16 side buffers passed a targeted test but produced NaNs on Cauchy and a cuBLAS failure at N=2048; conditional fp16 still NaN'd on Cauchy D=128 → reverted fully to fp32. Repeatedly traced heavy-tailed Cauchy numeric breakdown to the precision strategy and rolled back rather than pushing a falsified approach.

One more precision hypothesis (out_gate as fp16, reasoned safe since sigmoid∈[0,1]) tested against the domain, failed Cauchy D=256 masked, and was reverted — evidence-driven correction re-verified against previously-failing cases without regressing correctness.

Made a plan-level adaptation: accepted that largest shapes miss the latency gate and deliberately prioritized correctness across the full domain, ending on the verified fp32 path instead of shipping an unsafe fast variant.

reasoning: The agent consistently separated correctness failures from performance failures and root-caused each — breakdown timing led to the gate_pack tiling fix, and repeated Cauchy NaN/tolerance misses were traced to the reduced-precision accumulation strategy and reverted with re-verification, never regressing prior correctness wins (matching the level-8 anchor). It falls short of 10 because the reduced-precision attempts (bf16 → fp16 sides → conditional fp16 → out_gate fp16) were somewhat circular variations on one idea rather than a fresh redesign of the bottleneck, though it did ultimately adapt the plan itself by prioritizing correctness over the latency gate.
